name: briefgate
description: Client intake for AI agents: request files, texts and credentials from a client, chase automatically, get notified when complete.
long_description: BriefGate is a client-intake service an AI coding agent drives over MCP. Define what you need from a client (files, texts, choices, structured data, credentials), BriefGate emails them a no-account portal link, chases them automatically on a schedule until everything arrives, and hands typed results back to the agent — including secrets, decrypted and released exactly once. Works standalone from a dashboard too, for the parts of a project that don't involve an agent.

api_key.title: BriefGate API key
api_key.description: Optional. Get a free-tier key at https://briefgate.dev, or leave this blank and call the `login` tool from within Claude Desktop to sign in via device flow instead.
